shortDescription: Collects facts from remote PVOS device

options.name: gather_network_resources
options.description: Retrieve vlan, interface, acl, lacp interfaces or lldp neighbors information. This can be a single category or it can be a list. Leaving this field blank returns all interfaces, vlans, vlan-port assignments, loop protect status/ports/vlans, acl, lacp interfaces and lldp neighbors.

options.name: gather_subset
options.description: Retrieve a subset of all device information. This can be a single category or it can be a list. As warning, leaving this field blank returns all facts, which may be an intensive process.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.
